results.zero_return_excluded: For the supplied actual globally sliced exact1122 frame with full initial kernel(ZW-X^2Y^2), the exact ratio is q=t^2/rho. If R=0, then xi=y-(t/rho)theta is in L. The literal mixed derivative then makes w,z affine in theta, and actual whole-line equality makes theta affine. The actual auxiliary derivation P=aN-(NX)E is nice. Its row tau(p,p^2X+kappa,X+lambda), with p=t/rho transcendental over C, contradicts the fixed-linear-form theorem over C(X) by its highest X coefficient. Thus R cannot vanish identically. results.nonzero_return_projection: The full q_t-dependent universal potentials, including the quadratic w term and the mixed derivative, give an undivided sextic whose top is t V(rho U-tV)^4(2rho U-tV)/rho^11. Both potentials supply the gradient identities and calibrated R^3J0 identity, so the selected factor is simple and its evaluated cofactor divides R^3. Actual return gives O=C+Cw and RO contained in C. The pure leading-line degree theorem, a degree-five semigroup gap and unique cofactor leading degrees exclude cubic and quartic components. Hence C=L[y,theta]=L[v], and the plane component is a line or a conic. A conic has both y and theta of degree two and xi=y-(t/rho)theta affine.
results.line_recognition: There are exactly three possible line directions. The direction y=(t/rho)theta+nu is excluded by the actual nice-row obstruction. An actual good-coordinate interchange reduces the direction y=(t/(2rho))theta+nu to constant theta, with the new return explicitly nonzero. In the constant-theta chart, the full potential coefficients and scalar determinant force the affine w slope lambda to be complex. The actual coordinate U=W-lambda Y is P-invariant. Primitive division, the two-variable LND lemma and weighted leading independence force DY to be a nonzero complex constant, giving an explicit original polynomial auxiliary slice and both coordinate inverse orders. The original E restricts to its actual polynomial three-variable kernel; Daigle's fixed-coordinate theorem and the regular-kernel theorem then give an ambient E-invariant coordinate and A isomorphic C^[3].
results.conic_necessary_reduction: For theta=P(xi) quadratic, the actual tangent identity improves evaluated cofactor divisibility to q1 dividing R^2. The complete weight-eight part gives two radial branches with K=Dcal^2 k/2 nonzero: Dcal^3 k=0 and alpha=-1/(K rho^2), or Dcal^3 k=-6K/rho and alpha=1/(K rho^2), where Dcal=(t/rho)partial_t+partial_rho. The latter branch already has all projected intercepts of degree at most two. In the former, the actual constant swap X'=Y,Y'=X preserves the full ideal and literal selected partial and cancels the cubic intercept coefficient. Rebuilding the actual auxiliary derivation gives P^3Y=P^3Z=P^3W=0. This is not the square-zero hypothesis of the nice theorem and is not recognition or exclusion of the conic.
